the-expressionist.title: The Expressionist
the-expressionist.description: Wearing a gesture of tales, the expressionist.
the-expressionist.context:
I made The Expressionist after a moment that hit before I could think—brief, sudden, the kind that leaves you stunned before you understand why. I painted that pause between impact and explanation, before you can collect yourself and pretend you're fine.
The face in this work does not perform. Shock sits openly on it. Vulnerability is left as it is. I wasn't interested in understanding what happened. I was interested in holding what it felt like.
We tell ourselves our emotions are hidden. They rarely are.
The Expressionist is unpolished because the moment was. The vulnerability is the point.

controlled-chaos.title: Controlled Chaos
controlled-chaos.description: The chaos is obvious, but what you're really seeing is restraint.

el-santo.title: El Santo
el-santo.description:
Under the cover of darkness
looking beyond the enveloping dark void
appears a crucifix — wielding saint
her face wears a sadness
that stares deep at her defeat
telling a tale of how she became the haunted.

godfather.title: Godfather
godfather.description: Like a puppeteer orchestrating a dance of controlled chaos, the subtle movements of expression draw you into a reflective odyssey. Here, authority whispers, artistry seamlessly intertwines, and one experiences the unspoken harmony between power and chaos!

longshot.title: LONGSHOT
longshot.description: This is an ode to my darkest hour; A tribute to the spirit, unyielding and strong. A tale of audacity etched into every stroke, birthed from pursuit of dreams where the odds are stacked impossibly high.
longshot.context:
I made Longshot from surviving a period where stopping would have been easier than continuing.
The subject holds composure, carrying what kept me in motion — the version of myself I had to become when the hours demanded it.
The struggle does not end. It continues.
Longshot is what remains after becoming what was required when there was no other choice.

mesmerized.title: Mesmerized
mesmerized.description:
Mesmerized by the timeless tunnel's allure,
I peer within,
my senses keen and pure.
Every doubt, every uncertainty unfurls,
As my jaws drop, astonishment swirls,
I gaze upon the dreams and fears once held,
And find myself bewitched, completely compelled.
The tunnel's depths hold secrets untold,
A journey through time, a story to unfold.
mesmerized.context:
Some moments arrive without warning. They happen faster than comprehension allows—leaving you somewhere between awe and shock, lost in what just occurred.
Mesmerized was made for that instant. The rapid shift that takes time to register. The kind where past and present begin to collide.
A moment where composure breaks. Perception alters. And for an instant, nothing fully settles.

price-of-high.title: Price of High
price-of-high.description:
Have I not paid enough?
What price has to be paid to get high?
Whatever the cost is, the price is paid for in full.
What happens when you pay the price, and you don't get high?

the-centurion-guardian.title: The Centurion Guardian
the-centurion-guardian.description:
Her focus never falters nor wavers,
As she readies for the coming fight.
She is sworn to defend this folklore,
Her face tells tales of a hardened past,
Of battles fought and battles won.

the-messenger.title: The Messenger
the-messenger.description:
The messenger
deep into an endless cold night,
comes forth a bearer of whispers,
a messenger singing hymns of the rebirth.

the-outlaw.title: The Outlaw
the-outlaw.description:
A villain emerges in this story,
an outlaw,
a defiant aura of fright,
a dangerous soul, wild and dark.

the-reaper.title: The Reaper
the-reaper.description:
With ferocious gaze,
the reaper rips wandering soul apart,
feasting on them,
while relentless in the pursuit of its next prey.

the-silent-observer.title: The Silent Observer
the-silent-observer.description: Eavesdropping through every passing moment with obscurity and uncertainty, my inner chatter scream as those dotting eyes hover.

top-dog.title: Top Dog
top-dog.description: Becoming more, comes at a price! How much you're willing to pay, is a tale told by only those who wear their battle cry boldly. In this land you can evolve, thrive with your deep roots. It becomes grueling and harsh with the passing of time. But amidst the shadows and trials, a flicker ignites, a spark of resilience, refusing to bow to the night. A testament to strength, and a triumph over fear.
top-dog.context:
I made Top Dog as a portrait of earned dominance and what it costs.
The figure is a man in his early 30s. Dressed well. Seated deliberately. Aware of how he is being seen. His posture is controlled. He has arrived and knows it.
The suit, the chair, the gold stud earring—these are the face he presents. Status. Taste. Authority. That outward composure is the mask people are meant to read.
What sits over his face is something else. The skeletal form brings his inner state forward. Fatigue. Damage. Hunger. The emotions usually hidden are made visible here. The painting reverses the lie. What looks polished is the disguise. What looks distorted is the truth.
Behind him is a framed, shattered skull. Not decoration. A record. Like a hunter displaying proof of what was killed to survive. Success in this work is not clean. It leaves remains.
Top Dog is about power that was paid for.

enchanteur-i.title: Enchanteur I
enchanteur-i.description:
I can't keep my eyes off this piece,
that stare seems to watch like it's trying to tell me something,
a language written in whispers. With every stare, you're enchanted.
He is the Enchanteur, His eyes are like pools of mystery, drawing you deeper into his spell.
He knows your secrets and sees your desires; He whispers them back to you in his creation.
While he leaves you entranced in his beauty.
enchanteur-i.context:
I made Enchanteur with a single intention: to create something beautiful enough to hold attention.
There was no narrative guiding the work. I painted the figure without a story to tell—just the gaze, left open for the viewer to meet.
While working, I realized the painting was doing something through its beauty. Not demanding attention, but quietly keeping it.
Enchanteur is about what happens when you stay with something long enough. The looking eventually turns inward.

enchanteur-ii.title: Enchanteur II
enchanteur-ii.description:
A feminine mystique with imperfections concealed from the gazing eye,
Yet they kindle the fire, the strength to defy.
Every stare, an invitation to explore,
Eyes that mirror the secrets of her soul,
A gaze so profound, it beckons, it cajoles.
For in her stare, a narrative unfolds,
A story of strength, of tales untold.
An embodiment of elegance, guarding battles won,
An enchantress of grace and hidden might,
Concealing stories, resilient and bright.
enchanteur-ii.context:
Enchanteur II followed the first without a new intention, only a shift in presence.
I made this piece for what stays hidden.
The figure holds herself with composure. Nothing is offered forward. Nothing is explained.
Her gaze remains steady. It holds.
Enchanteur II is about elegance that guards what it took to arrive.

masked-menace.title: Masked Menace
masked-menace.description:
Masked Menace is a title that emphasizes the dark and ominous quality of the artwork. The word menace suggests that there is something threatening or dangerous about the character, which is reinforced by the description of the skull mask and the overall tone of the painting.
The word "masked" adds another layer of meaning to the title, as it suggests that the character is hiding his true identity or intentions behind the mask. Masks are often used in art and literature to represent deception, mystery, or the duality of human nature. In this case, the mask may be seen as a symbol of the character's hidden motives or intentions, which are hinted at but not fully revealed in the artwork.
Overall, Masked Menace is a title that captures the dark, mysterious, and threatening qualities of the artwork, while also suggesting deeper layers of meaning and symbolism.

rebel.title: REBEL
rebel.description: An obligation to be true to oneself. A debt that needs to be repaid. For a lack of settlement within leads to self-destruction. Rage on at every instance that aims to confine. Be a rebel of your true and complete self. This artwork is an ode to the unapologetic. It beckons viewers to question, to challenge, and to find solace in the beautifully dissonant symphony of their own rebellions. REBEL is an invitation to embrace the facets that make us unique, to revel in the artistic defiance that reshapes our world, and to recognize that within the clash of contrasts, we discover the most profound truths about ourselves. In every brushstroke, REBEL roars with the vibrancy of identity, the audacity of artistic innovation, and the resolute courage to stand apart. It is a testament to the human spirit's endless capacity to rebel against the ordinary and embrace the extraordinary!
rebel.context:
I made Rebel about an obligation I believe we owe ourselves—the debt of being who we actually are.
When that debt goes unpaid, when you spend too long pretending or conforming, it doesn't just sit quietly. It turns inward. It becomes self-destruction. The conflict isn't always visible from outside, but it's constant.
The figure in this work carries that tension. Marked, worn, defiant. Not rebelling for show, but because the alternative is collapse.
Rebel is about the instances that try to confine you—and the refusal to let them.

god-is-a-woman.title: God is a Woman
god-is-a-woman.description: She was created from a rib cage, it is her genesis, her humble beginning. A beautiful creation whose perfect imperfection soils from the very smell of her existence to the strand of her dark hair, resolute with solid beliefs that are unfazed against high odds. Her beautiful soul gazes on us beings and hypnotizes us with her gorgeousness. She is bright, alluring and assertive. Her dominance is undeniable as her body generates a desire only her hormones can sense. Her body, the beauty and the pain she bears are unparalleled. But, her duty as a bearer of life makes her a god. She is a Woman, she is a god, God is a Woman.

pain.title: Pain
pain.description: If this pain breaks me — all that is left is fleeting memory of being whole, fading remembrance of my resolve. With each hurting moment, I've been torn to pieces, shredded of every healing wall put up, fighting every sting of pain while hoping to get stronger, patiently waiting to be sewn together. But what if I can't outlast this hurt? What if I don't get better? What if my wounded heart fails to heal? Here I lay deformed of courage and the will to push on, maybe this is what I need to begin a new chapter. It won't be long now, whatever comes after this feels eternity away. Death to the pain that broke me.
